cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 ST7798 R14.39 LAB — 369 Fork/Upstream RF Cases
cyd32-st7798.summary: R14.39 LAB 369 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi cases. Adds two fork-specific 28-bit MA-M drone-prefix test beacons (Inspired Flight and ZeroZero) and five exact BLE serial-module-name advertisements. Keeps upstream v1.50 defaults and records 19 fork-specific expected results separately; source tests do not prove actual receiver detection. Preserves working R14.38 gear/settings BACK navigation. No unauthorized radio transmission. SHA-256 multi-part firmware flashing for CYD 3.2 ST7798.
highlights: 369 selectable bounded RF tests: 362 prior fixtures plus two 28-bit drone prefixes and five BLE names.
Source-pinned upstream v1.50 220/220 static matches retained; 19 fork-only expectation overrides recorded separately.
Inspired Flight and ZeroZero 28-bit Wi-Fi AP MAC prefixes applied with exact high-nibble matching.
Five additional BLE-name tests under SERIAL MODULES: BT04, JDY-09, JDY-10, JDY-17, SPP-C.
R14.38 navigation behavior unchanged; RF receiver testing still pending.
Case-unique addresses; transmitter remains operator-triggered and time-limited.
